law: Packet egress is derived, never packet-authorized. GATE > NOW > RESIDUE > NEXT > DELTA > ARCHIVE. Historical/superseded material collapses to ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated; reactivation only reopens evaluation; only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context can create NOW.

/showcase-manifest.json — FIELD root touch only; no new route/version

preserves: historical worker packets remain non-runnable by presence
no new route, dashboard, queue, store, planner, ontology, or canonical packet cache
residue: The reducer classifies structure; it does not decide project priority or execute NEXT.
External/private packets are reduced only when explicitly supplied to the existing transcript CLI.

precedence: GATE > NOW > RESIDUE > NEXT > DELTA > ARCHIVE

RESIDUE outranks NEXT and DELTA; an unwitnessed material-change claim reduces to RESIDUE rather than DELTA.
STOP dominates continuation: STOP+condition -> GATE; STOP+residue -> RESIDUE; otherwise STOP -> ARCHIVE.
Canonical exists:false/material:false fields do not manufacture attention; explicit authority.can_select_now=false blocks selected NOW and survives as RESIDUE.
